title: Family Group Portrait in Kansas, 1920s B&W Snapshot Photo
back_text_transcription: A10 Grandma Schmid Aunt Lydia Mom & Dad Muriel Jeanette & Norman in Kansas
description: A classic 1920s black and white snapshot depicting a multi-generational family posed outside a wooden house in Kansas. The adults are dressed in typical Roaring Twenties attire, featuring women in drop-waist floral dresses and cloche hats, and a man wearing a bowtie and suit jacket. Three young children stand in front. To the right, a traditional manual water pump rests on a concrete porch slab.
